newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Climax says Didipio decision in 1997.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Climax says Didipio decision in 1997.

text.p: Climax Mining Ltd said on Thursday it should be in a position to make a decision to mine its Didipio copper/gold project in the Philippines in the second half of 1997.
Chairman Adrian Fletcher told the annual general meeting that Climax was in a strong financial position following the sale of non-core assets which realised more than $A70 million.
A feasibility study on the Dinkidi deposit was completed in February, prompting the company to boost its stake to 92 per cent and strengthen its balance sheet, he said.
A number of mining methods had been subject to review since March. This had included discussions with a number of major mining houses who had expressed an interest in the project.

"No decision in this regard will be made until the current optimisation studies, and a further 10,000 metres of drilling to test the full extent of the high grade core, have been completed," Fletcher said.
Dinkidi lies in the Didipio mineral province and the deposit has been shown to contain more than 4.0 million ounces of gold and 1.1 billion pounds of copper.
